# PAO OS - Business Operating System

> PAO OS - Business Operating System: Hệ thống AI thông minh dành cho doanh nghiệp. PAO OS belongs to IVN Network; its managing company is IVN Media Joint Stock Company in Vietnam.

PAO OS is the product and brand. IVN Network is the organization to which PAO OS belongs. IVN Media is the managing company, legally named Công ty cổ phần công nghệ truyền thông IVN Media (IVN Media Joint Stock Company). These names refer to distinct roles and should not be used interchangeably.

This is the official public product website at https://pao-os.com/. It introduces PAO's capabilities in planning, work coordination, marketing, customer operations, enterprise knowledge and collaboration between people and AI agents. Vietnamese, English and Simplified Chinese versions are available.

The website describes the product and its intended uses. Capabilities and integrations depend on each business's configuration and deployment. Consult the privacy policy for information about data handling. Business contact: cs@pao-os.com; hotline: 0925880088.

## Official website

- [Full PAO OS overview for AI](https://pao-os.com/llms-full.txt): Product identity, ownership, business capabilities, contact details and data handling in one Markdown document.
- [PAO OS - Tiếng Việt](https://pao-os.com/): Vietnamese product introduction, capabilities, workflow, AI team, knowledge, use cases and frequently asked questions.
- [PAO OS - English](https://pao-os.com/en/): English product information.
- [PAO OS - Simplified Chinese](https://pao-os.com/zh/): Simplified Chinese product information.

## Product information

- [About PAO - Vietnamese](https://pao-os.com/gioi-thieu/): PAO's story, AI Chief of Staff and Multi-Agent coordination approach, SME audience, development principles, IVN Network and long-term vision. PAO has been introduced to the market and continues to be refined; actual functionality depends on the product version, configuration and supported integrations.
- [About PAO - English](https://pao-os.com/en/gioi-thieu/): English version of the official introduction.
- [About PAO - Simplified Chinese](https://pao-os.com/zh/gioi-thieu/): Simplified Chinese version of the official introduction.
- [Capabilities](https://pao-os.com/#kha-nang): AI assistance, business workspace, marketing, customer operations, automation and enterprise knowledge.
- [How PAO works](https://pao-os.com/#quy-trinh): Goals, planning, coordination and review.
- [AI team](https://pao-os.com/#doi-ngu): Functional roles and their coordination through PAO.
- [Enterprise knowledge](https://pao-os.com/#tri-thuc): Connections between business information, work and context.
- [Use cases](https://pao-os.com/#trai-nghiem): Examples of how PAO can support business workflows.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://pao-os.com/#cau-hoi): Answers to common product questions.

## Business solution areas

- [PAO solutions - Vietnamese](https://pao-os.com/giai-phap/): Six areas covering management, marketing, CRM and sales, workflow automation, system integration and Multi-Agent coordination; deployment approach and integration limits.
- [PAO solutions - English](https://pao-os.com/en/giai-phap/): English version of the solution overview.
- [PAO solutions - Simplified Chinese](https://pao-os.com/zh/giai-phap/): Simplified Chinese version of the solution overview.

These are application directions, not a guarantee that all functions are available. Availability depends on product version, configuration, integration readiness and granted permissions.

## Features, development team, knowledge and deployment

- [PAO features - Vietnamese](https://pao-os.com/tinh-nang/): AI Chief of Staff, Multi-Agent, Business Workspace, content, marketing, CRM, knowledge, workflow automation, integrations and access control. Availability depends on release and configuration; planned capabilities are not a promise of current availability.
- [PAO features - English](https://pao-os.com/en/tinh-nang/): English feature overview.
- [PAO features - Simplified Chinese](https://pao-os.com/zh/tinh-nang/): Simplified Chinese feature overview.
- [Development team - Vietnamese](https://pao-os.com/doi-ngu/): IVN Network, product development approach, technical disciplines and collaboration. This describes the development organization, not the AI Agent roles on the homepage.
- [Development team - English](https://pao-os.com/en/doi-ngu/): English development team information.
- [Development team - Simplified Chinese](https://pao-os.com/zh/doi-ngu/): Simplified Chinese development team information.
- [PAO Insights - Vietnamese](https://pao-os.com/blog/): Five knowledge categories, introductory topics and editorial principles. Topic descriptions are not individual published articles.
- [PAO Insights - English](https://pao-os.com/en/blog/): English knowledge overview.
- [PAO Insights - Simplified Chinese](https://pao-os.com/zh/blog/): Simplified Chinese knowledge overview.
- [Download and deployment - Vietnamese](https://pao-os.com/download/): Cloud/VPS and Desktop directions, comparison and preparation. Cloud/VPS deployment is being developed and refined; Desktop is on the roadmap with no official installer announced. No installer download is currently provided on this page.
- [Download and deployment - English](https://pao-os.com/en/download/): English deployment information.
- [Download and deployment - Simplified Chinese](https://pao-os.com/zh/download/): Simplified Chinese deployment information.
